description: Approved scope-boundary updates for existing GEA roadmap issues. Preview by default; apply only after explicit workflow confirmation.

updates.title_prefix: SEC-2: Limit student data by role
updates.body:
# Goal
Establish the shared backend authorization foundation for student-record access. Return only records and fields permitted for the signed-in user's role and assignments.

# Scope owned by this issue
- Drivers: scope student queries to the authenticated driver's explicitly assigned route and return only approved rider fields.
- Teachers: scope student list, detail, search and related student queries to classes assigned to that teacher.
- Clerks/accountants: expose only student and fee-related fields required for approved office duties. Teacher fee/payment/collection endpoint restrictions remain in SEC-3.
- Admins: permit access according to the approved school permissions policy.
- Enforce authorization in backend dependencies, service/query filters and response schemas. UI hiding is not an access-control boundary.
- Apply the same scope to list, detail, search and direct-ID access; reject requests outside the user's assignment.
- Add reusable policy helpers where appropriate so modules do not create conflicting permission rules.
- Verify driver identity is explicitly and securely associated with a driver record. Never infer the association by matching names or phone numbers.
- Confirm the meaning and source of driver stop and guardian-contact fields before mapping them to existing student fields. Do not assume a generic mobile field is the guardian phone.

# Out of scope
- Driver screens and route UI (TRN-3).
- Student list/detail presentation and interaction (STU-1, STU-2, STU-3).
- Teacher fee/payment/collection endpoint restrictions (SEC-3).
- Report/export-specific policies and audit behavior (RPT and PRV tasks).

# Done when
- API tests cover driver, teacher, clerk/accountant and admin roles.
- Drivers cannot retrieve students outside their assigned route.
- Teachers cannot retrieve students outside their assigned classes.
- Unauthorized fields are absent from API responses, not merely hidden in the frontend.
- List, detail, search and direct-ID access enforce consistent restrictions.
- Missing or ambiguous assignment links fail closed.
- Existing authorized admin workflows remain functional.

# Dependencies
- Approved role and data-field policy from the roadmap foundation.
- Driver-to-user association must be established safely before driver-scoped access can work for existing driver accounts.

# Size
M

updates.title_prefix: SEC-3: Hide fee data from teachers
updates.body:
# Goal
Prevent the teacher role from viewing or retrieving fee, payment and collection data through fee-specific APIs and dashboard/report data sources.

# Scope owned by this issue
- Remove teacher access from fee, payment, invoice, dues and collection endpoints, including APIs used by Reports, Charts and Dashboard.
- Return a consistent authorization refusal for unsupported teacher fee requests.
- Preserve approved fee access for clerks/accountants and admins.
- Ensure teacher dashboard and report data sources do not include fee values.
- Add positive and negative API tests for teacher, clerk/accountant and admin roles.
- Reuse the shared authorization foundation established by SEC-2; do not create a separate student-record permission system.

# Out of scope
- General student list/detail/search scoping and driver/teacher assignment filtering (SEC-2).
- Dashboard layout and role-specific presentation (DSH-1).
- Report navigation and report-specific presentation (RPT-1, RPT-3).

# Done when
- Teachers receive an authorization refusal when directly requesting fee/payment/collection APIs.
- Fee data is not present in teacher dashboard or report API payloads.
- Clerks/accountants and admins retain their approved fee access.
- Tests cover direct API requests and relevant dashboard/report data sources.

# Dependencies
- SEC-2 shared backend authorization foundation.

# Size
M

# Goal
Safeguard printed and exported school data by limiting output to approved columns and recording export activity.

# Work
- Audit every CSV export and print layout for purpose-specific, minimum-required columns.
- Apply role and record restrictions supplied by SEC-2 and fee restrictions from SEC-3; do not duplicate their base access-control logic.
- Add a short children's-data handling banner to printouts and exports where appropriate.
- Add export audit entries with actor and time, but never store exported sensitive values in the audit entry.
- Allow an admin to disable exports for restricted roles according to the approved school policy.
- Test direct export endpoints and print-data sources, not only visibility of UI actions.

# Done when
- Reports and exports contain only approved columns and authorized records.
- CSV and print actions create audit entries without sensitive values.
- Restricted exports are blocked or disabled according to role policy.
- Tests verify allowed and denied export scenarios.

# Dependencies
- PRV-6 audit trail.
- SEC-2 role-scoped data authorization.
- SEC-3 fee-data restrictions.

# Size
M

updates.title_prefix: STU-1: Add server-side student paging, search and filters
updates.body:
<!-- GEA-ROADMAP:STU-1 -->

## Goal
Make the authorized student list complete and easy to navigate.

## Work
- Add server-side pagination and search.
- Filter by class, route and student status.
- Preserve page and filters when returning from student details.
- Consume the role-scoped student results provided by SEC-2; do not implement a second authorization policy.
- Calculate pagination totals, search matches and filter options only from records the current user is authorized to access.

## Done when
- All authorized students are reachable; the list is not capped at 100.
- Search and filters run server-side and cannot reveal out-of-scope records or counts.
- Returning preserves list position and filters.
- Tests cover pagination and filters for representative roles.

## Dependencies
- SEC-2 role-scoped student data.

## Size
M

updates.title_prefix: STU-2: Build a phone-first student list
updates.body:
<!-- GEA-ROADMAP:STU-2 -->

## Goal
Make everyday student lookup fast on small screens.

## Work
- Use student cards on phone layouts.
- Show name, class, roll and route only when each field is present in the authorized API response.
- Add a guardian-call action only when the role may access the contact value and the school has approved that use.
- Open student details on card selection.
- Ensure touch targets are at least 44px.
- Treat SEC-2 backend response filtering as the security boundary; do not rely on frontend field hiding.

## Done when
- Works at 360px in light and dark themes.
- Cards display only fields returned as authorized for the current role.
- Interactive controls have 44px touch targets.
- Unauthorized contact details are never embedded in page or client-side state.

## Dependencies
- SEC-2 role-scoped student data.

## Size
M

---
**Epic:** #75
**Roadmap:** GEA UI, privacy and security plan

updates.title_prefix: STU-3: Add role-aware student detail tabs
updates.body:
<!-- GEA-ROADMAP:STU-3 -->

## Goal
Provide a student detail page with tabs that reflect the current user's permissions.

## Work
- Add Profile, Attendance, Marks, Fees and Transport tabs where those modules are available.
- Show or hide tabs according to the shared role policy and capabilities of the relevant APIs.
- Consume SEC-2 and SEC-3 backend authorization; UI tab visibility is not a substitute for API enforcement.
- Keep each tab's data request limited to its own authorized module.
- Add loading, empty and error states.

## Done when
- Teachers do not see or retrieve fee data.
- Clerks cannot retrieve restricted academic data.
- Unauthorized tab endpoints remain inaccessible when called directly.
- API integration tests prove the detail page handles allowed and denied responses correctly.

## Dependencies
- SEC-2 role-scoped student data.
- SEC-3 fee-data restrictions.

## Size
L

---
**Epic:** #75
**Roadmap:** GEA UI, privacy and security plan

updates.title_prefix: STU-7: Mask sensitive student fields by default
updates.body:
<!-- GEA-ROADMAP:STU-7 -->

## Goal
Reduce unnecessary exposure of student and guardian contact details in the student interface.

## Work
- Mask mobile/contact numbers by default, showing only the last four digits where appropriate.
- Provide a reveal action only to roles with an approved purpose and backend authorization.
- Log authorized reveals through the sensitive-data audit mechanism without storing the revealed value.
- Ensure full values are not exposed in page source, unrelated API payloads, client-side logs or hidden DOM elements.
- Use SEC-2 to determine whether the user may access the underlying contact field; masking is an additional display safeguard, not a replacement for authorization.

## Done when
- Sensitive contact fields are masked by default.
- Only authorized roles can retrieve/reveal the full value.
- Reveal actions appear in the audit trail without recording the number.
- Unauthorized users cannot obtain the full value by calling the API directly.

## Dependencies
- SEC-2 role-scoped student data.
- PRV-6 sensitive-data audit trail.

## Size
S

<!-- GEA-ROADMAP:DSH-1 -->

## Goal
Show each staff role only the information and tasks needed for its work, using authorized real data.

## Work
- Admin: approved school summary, collection and today's attendance.
- Teacher: assigned classes, attendance not yet marked and marks pending; no fee information.
- Clerk/accountant: approved collection and overdue-fee information.
- Build role-specific dashboard presentation and metrics using the relevant authorized APIs.
- Do not implement a separate student or fee authorization layer; rely on SEC-2 for student scoping and SEC-3 for teacher fee restrictions.
- Use real database/API values only; show empty states when no data exists.

## Done when
- Each role lands on its intended dashboard.
- Dashboard requests and responses contain only data authorized for that role.
- Figures match underlying authorized API data.
- Empty datasets never produce demo numbers.
- Tests verify dashboard data sources for each role.

## Dependencies
- SEC-2 role-scoped student data.
- SEC-3 fee-data restrictions.

## Size
L

updates.title_prefix: DSH-3: Add today's attendance status panel
updates.body:
<!-- GEA-ROADMAP:DSH-3 -->

## Goal
Help teachers and administrators see which classes completed attendance today.

## Work
- Show attendance-marked and not-yet-marked classes for the current school day.
- Link each class to its attendance workflow.
- Use SEC-2's shared assignment policy so teachers see only their assigned classes; do not create a separate class-access rule in this dashboard task.
- Handle holidays, weekends and classes without enrolled students using school rules.

## Done when
- Status uses actual attendance records and school calendar rules.
- Teachers see only assigned classes in both the panel and its data source.
- Admins can identify classes with pending attendance.
- Each item links to the relevant attendance screen.
- Tests cover teacher and admin visibility.

## Dependencies
- SEC-2 role-scoped student data.

## Size
M

updates.title_prefix: DSH-4: Add accessible real-data dashboard charts
updates.body:
<!-- GEA-ROADMAP:DSH-4 -->

## Goal
Present attendance and fee trends accurately with an accessible alternative to charts.

## Work
- Add attendance trend and monthly collection charts using real API data.
- Provide a table with the same values for accessibility.
- Use SEC-2 and SEC-3 authorization for the underlying data; this task owns chart presentation and matching table output, not a separate permission system.
- Ensure teachers cannot retrieve fee chart data, including by directly requesting the chart data endpoint.
- Support light/dark themes and responsive layouts.

## Done when
- Chart and table values match.
- No sample data is used.
- Teachers cannot retrieve fee chart data.
- Authorized roles see only permitted metrics.
- Charts work on mobile and in both themes.

## Dependencies
- SEC-2 role-scoped student data.
- SEC-3 fee-data restrictions.

## Size
M

updates.title_prefix: TRN-3: Create a driver view limited to the assigned route
updates.body:
<!-- GEA-ROADMAP:TRN-3 -->

## Goal
Build a driver-facing transport view that uses the authorized route and rider data provided by the backend.

## Work
- Show the signed-in driver's assigned route and rider list using the SEC-2-authorized API.
- Display only rider fields returned by that API and approved for the driver's purpose.
- Build the route/rider screen, loading, empty and denied states, and appropriate navigation.
- Do not implement a second route-scoping or student-field authorization mechanism in the frontend.
- Do not assume an existing generic mobile field is the guardian phone; use only the contact field explicitly approved and supplied by the API.

## Done when
- The driver view displays only the signed-in driver's authorized route.
- No other-route data is requested or displayed.
- Only approved rider fields are rendered.
- UI tests cover normal, empty and denied access states.

## Dependencies
- SEC-2 backend route and field authorization.
- A verified driver-account-to-driver-record association.

## Size
M

---
**Epic:** #77
**Roadmap:** GEA UI, privacy and security plan

updates.title_prefix: RPT-1: Create a unified role-aware reports index
updates.body:
<!-- GEA-ROADMAP:RPT-1 -->

## Goal
Provide named, consistent school reports with safe filtering, printing and CSV export.

## Work
- Add reports for class list, attendance register, marks sheet, fee dues and route list.
- Provide relevant filters for each report.
- Add Print and CSV actions where permitted.
- Remove the full-profile students-by-driver report.
- Document the purpose, required columns and allowed roles for every report.
- Consume SEC-2 and SEC-3-authorized data; do not implement a parallel student/fee authorization layer.
- Coordinate output restrictions and export audit behavior with PRV-8.

## Done when
- Each report lists its purpose, columns and permitted roles.
- Reports return only required fields and authorized records.
- Print and CSV actions respect authorization and export safeguards.
- Tests verify report contents for allowed and denied roles.

## Dependencies
- SEC-2 role-scoped student data.
- SEC-3 fee-data restrictions.
- PRV-8 export and print safeguards.

## Size
L

**Epic:** #78
**Roadmap:** GEA UI, privacy and security plan

updates.title_prefix: RPT-3: Enforce report access by staff role
updates.body:
<!-- GEA-ROADMAP:RPT-3 -->

## Goal
Apply report-specific role rules consistently, using the shared backend authorization foundation.

## Work
- Define and document the report catalogue and allowed roles for each report.
- Teachers: academic reports only.
- Clerks/accountants: approved fee reports and only other reports required for their duties.
- Admins: all reports approved by school policy.
- Enforce report-level access in report API endpoints and navigation.
- Use SEC-2 for student-record and assignment scoping and SEC-3 for teacher fee restrictions; do not duplicate those base policies.
- Add positive and negative tests for each report and relevant role.

## Done when
- Teachers cannot retrieve fee reports, including by direct API request.
- Clerks/accountants cannot retrieve restricted academic reports.
- Admins can access all approved reports.
- Every report has documented allowed roles and required columns.
- Tests verify allowed and denied access.

## Dependencies
- SEC-2 role-scoped student data.
- SEC-3 fee-data restrictions.

## Size
S
